items: ✅【Keyboard Case for Galaxy Tab A9 Plus 11I inch】ONLY Compatible with Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+ / A9 Plus 11-inch 2023 Model number(SM-X210/X216/X218), Please check your tablet model "SM-Xxxx" in your tablet "Settings" before purchasing. ●●●NOTE: this keyboard case is not suitable for S9 11 inches, S9 FE 10.9 inch.

✅【7 Colors RGB Backlight Keyboard】Switch the backlit of the keys with 7 different colors and 3 levels of brightness. 7 RGB colors backlight makes the colors of the keyboard brighter and more vibrant, creating a more enjoyable working and entertainment atmosphere. 3 brightness modes make it easier to see and use the keys in dimly lit environments, thus enhancing functionality.

✅【Multi-angle View &Magnetic Detachable】This Samsung A9 plus tablet case keyboard has multiple viewing angles, allowing you to use the tablet at a comfortable tilt angle and enjoy reading, typing, sketching, chatting, etc. Wireless keyboard can be attached to the case magnetically. The keyboard is easy to attach and remove from the magnetic cover, simple and portable. Created to take your Galaxy Tab A9 Plus to the next level of everyday use.

✅【Powerful Battery & Stable Bluetooth Connection】The Samsung A9 Plus tablet case keyboard adopts the more general type-c interface, charging for 2-3 hours, and can work continuously for up to 90 hours under normal use. Galaxy tab A9 Plus/A9+ case with keyboard comes with power-saving mode, long periods of non-use will enter the hibernation state. Convenient and fast Bluetooth connection allows you to use the galaxy tab A9+ 5G case with keyboard anywhere, anytime.

✅【Full Protection for Samsung Galaxy Tab A9+】Our Galaxy tab A9 Plus case with keyboard made of soft TPU and flexible TPU inner shell, which are drop-proof and scratch resistant, also not slippery or stick while carrying it around, greatly reduces the damage to your tablet caused by collisions. The inner lining of the case features a honeycomb design that helps dissipate heat from the tablet, improving the performance and extending the life of the Samsung A9+ tablet.

✅【【Auto Sleep/Wake Function】The samsung galaxy A9 Plus case with keyboard automatically sleeps or wakes up the tablet screen when you open or close it, which helps to protect and save the battery life and keep all the important things you may be working on safe and private. Notice: The galaxy A9 plus tablet keyboard will enter into sleep mode if it doesn't work for 10 minutes, and it will disconnect with your tablet. It will wake up and connect to your tablet again when pressing any key.

✅【S Pen Slot 】Galaxy Tab A9 plus case with keyboard comes with a specially designed S Pen holder, which not only makes it easy to use the S Pen, but also prevents the S Pen from getting lost or in the way (Note: S Pen is not included).

✅【100% Satisfaction】Our Galaxy tab a9 plus keyboard meet the need of gamers, typists, programmers, and writers, and combines your office and gaming experience. In order to better serve my lovely customers, We will provide you 12-month warranty and 30-day money-back guarantee since your purchase date. At the same time, if you have any question and need, please feel free to contact us, we will solve your problem within 24 hours.
✅【NOTE】Tablet and S Pen are NOT included.
